story: Seraphina is chosen by the king to defeat the Shadow Wyvern threatening the kingdom. She travels with her companion Elric through dangerous lands and faces many challenges. Along the journey, she discovers she is part of an ancient prophecy. Accepting her destiny, she finds strength within herself and defeats the Wyvern, bringing peace back to the kingdom.
